sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5), names/descriptions/grades
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies, progress targets and rarity
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies, hidden split and Xbox Gamerscore (totals 1,000G)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Work the roadmap in order; the last trophy you earn is usually A Long Road at 100% completion.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the Gone Fishing story mission. It is an early story beat, so play the story in order and it will come to you; no side work is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Story only — keep playing the main missions and the chapter end triggers it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The asterisks are in the official name as PlayStation publishes it. Story only.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Story only — the chapter end is the trigger, nothing else to collect.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Story only — play the main missions through to the chapter end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the last story beat; once it pops, only the cleanup trophies (collectibles, activities, money) stand between you and the platinum.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that mission and it pops.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that heist and it pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that mission and it pops.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that mission and it pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that airport mission and it pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. A named mission trophy — finish that mission and it pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion (PSN tracks 0/100). This is the long grind and it folds in the collectibles, activities and exploration trophies below, so leave it for last and work the roadmap phases in order.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/100); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 100G).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts (PSN tracks 0/250). Stunts are jumps and air tricks — chain them during free roam and races instead of hunting them one by one, and let the count climb as you play.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/250); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 40G).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (PSN tracks 0/9). Sample everything — racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade, drone races and the rest — one go each is enough.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/9); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSN tracks 0/42). Learn each range's weapon pattern, replay the ones you miss, and save the hardest golds for when your aim is warm.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/42); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 40G).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (PSN tracks 0/14). Learn each course's line; one win per location is enough, so move on as soon as each pops.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/14); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 15G).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (PSN tracks 0/20). Variety counts, not repeats — enter new race types and tracks until the count hits 20.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/20); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge, match Cal's pace, and reel steadily rather than rushing — a calm line wins it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through once — any arcade game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final stranger mission. Finish Andy's whole strand to the end — the trophy is the strand's last mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final stranger mission. Finish Kenton's whole strand to the end — the trophy is the strand's last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final stranger mission. Finish Billy's whole strand to the end — the trophy is the strand's last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida (PSN tracks 0/8). Work every stranger icon you meet; each strand ends in a final mission of its own, and the eighth strand's end pops this.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/8); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 30G).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final stranger mission. Finish Randy's whole strand to the end — the trophy is the strand's last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final stranger mission. Finish Tyrone's whole strand to the end — the trophy is the strand's last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida (PSN tracks 0/18). POSSIBLY MISSABLE: GTABase / PowerPyx via EGamers report one meditation spot as Chapter-1-only, while PlanetGTA6 says it cannot be told yet. Meditate at every spot the moment you find it, starting in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save before big missions.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/18); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 10G); missable dispute: GTABase / PowerPyx via EGamers vs PlanetGTA6.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's stranger strand; the hunt target is a one-off animal, so take the shot when it is offered and do not spook it away.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets (PSN tracks 0/3). Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick them up as you explore, and keep sets together rather than scattering your effort.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/3); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 30G).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations (PSN tracks 0/100). Photograph landmarks as you travel; it stacks naturally with exploring the whole map for The Goodtime State.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/100); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 30G).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges (PSN tracks 0/50). Challenges cover driving, combat and world feats — check the challenge list often and clear the easy ones first.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/50); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 5G).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. PARTNER-GATED: do this while your partner is available to play with. Build heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. PARTNER-GATED: do this while your partner is available. Plan three nearby shops, rob fast, and keep moving between them so the heat never drops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (PSN tracks 0/100). Drive or enter new vehicle models; the count rises as you meet new ones, so try every car, bike, boat and plane you see.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/100); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends — a crowded fight is the right moment.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Leave the airport by a route that is not a scheduled flight — stealing a plane and taking off is the plain reading of it.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Trigger unconfirmed at launch: the description points at the Rhino tank. Try the Rhino's cannon in free roam and check back as launch guides firm up — this guide will not invent a step the sources do not pin down.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses, and out before anyone spots you. If you are seen, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (PSN tracks 0/5). Vaults are the big jobs — plan the escape route before you crack each one, and count each clean getaway.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/5); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 40G).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on a quiet road, crack it open, and lose the heat before it builds.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida (PSN tracks 0/52). Drive every region and the map fills in as you cover it — pair this with WAiNK It photos and vehicle discovery.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/52); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (PSN tracks 0/9). Hit one operation per gang and keep a note of which gangs you have done.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/9); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact bar is unconfirmed at launch — look for a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail there; this guide will not invent a location the sources do not pin down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact showroom is unconfirmed at launch — the description points at driving a car through a showroom front, in the style of the classic scene.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game at that alley — follow through on the throw and the frame should count.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Trigger unconfirmed at launch: the description points at a partnership milestone. Watch for it while playing with your partner and check back as launch guides firm up.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PSN tracks 0/500 choices. This counts choices across the game — keep playing and making decisions and the count climbs on its own; it is a long passive grind, not a single event.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/500); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 5G).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger unconfirmed at launch: the wording points at failing once and succeeding on the retry. If something fails on your first try, try it again right away — the second attempt may be the one that counts.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger unconfirmed at launch: the wording points at a strange world event. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and watch for something out of the ordinary.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a group and knock them down with a melee swing from the vehicle — a crowded pavement is the place to try it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts (PSN tracks 0/250000). Launder steadily through contacts as you earn — it is a money total, not a single haul, so it builds up over the whole game.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/250000); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 20G).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (PSN tracks 0/100000). Ordinary shopping counts — clothes, food, ammo — and big purchases like vehicles move it along fastest.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/100000); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 15G).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (PSN tracks 0/8). Buy every garage as money allows — they also store the vehicles you need for Whip It Good and On the Spot.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/8); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 15G).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (PSN tracks 0/10). Register vehicles you own through the app, one by one — any ten registered vehicles count.
trophies.source: Exophase + PSNProfiles (name, description, grade, target 0/10); PlanetGTA6 (Gamerscore 15G).

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.note: Chapters 1–4 and every named mission. Story only; meditate at every spot you pass (see #28 — possibly missable).

roadmap.title: Strangers & freaks
roadmap.note: Finish all 8 stranger strands, including Bret's hunt. Do the partner trophies (#33, #34) while your partner is available.

roadmap.title: Activities & skills
roadmap.note: Stunts, races, drone races, shooting range gold, fishing, arcade and Combat Focus. Sample every activity type early for #16.

roadmap.title: Crime & partners
roadmap.note: Vaults, armored truck, jewelry store, gang operations — plus the two partner-gated trophies, done while your partner is around.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & the world
roadmap.note: Meditation spots, cards, WAiNK photos, vehicles, all 52 areas, challenges, and the five cryptic secret trophies.

roadmap.title: Money & platinum
roadmap.note: Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages, register 10 vehicles — then 100% completion and the platinum pop.

missables.note: GTABase / PowerPyx via EGamers report one meditation spot as Chapter-1-only; PlanetGTA6 says it cannot be told yet. Meditate at every spot from Chapter 1 and keep a manual save before big missions.

missables.level: PARTNER-GATED — do it while your partner is available
missables.note: Needs your partner beside you to lose a 4-star wanted level together. Not confirmed missable, but the partner may not always be available — do it at the first good chance.

missables.level: PARTNER-GATED — do it while your partner is available
missables.note: Needs your partner beside you to rob 3 shops back-to-back. Same caution as #33: do it at the first good chance.
